what: Uses an in-memory set to record processed webhook event IDs and skips processing if the ID has already been seen.
why: Stripe can deliver the same event multiple times; the in-memory set prevents double‑charging until a proper idempotency solution (ticket PAY-212) is added.
revisit_condition: When the database‑level idempotency fix described in ticket PAY-212 is deployed, the in‑memory duplicate check can be removed.
